{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Mais dis-moi, t'es d'passage ici, toi

Und doch schmelzen sie alle, wenn

Selbstgespräche nich' belauschen!

{{TAG:0005:0005:}} viene sempre qui a

{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}

nada que ver!

como yo, ¡no hay estación que
se le resista, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ho già dormito all'aperto d'estate{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
ma sapevo che in inverno non
sarebbe stato così facile!
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Mi sono fatta in quattro
per costruirlo, ma sono contenta
di avere questo igloo, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}In meiner Bande haben wir 'ne
Mutprobe:{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Eine Nacht unter freiem
Himmel schlafen –{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ohne Zelt!
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Für mich ist das natürlich kein
Problem{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Trotzdem penn ich
diesmal lieber im Iglu, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Yazın daha önce dışarıda uyudum{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}ama
kışın dışarıda uyumak bayağı sert olur!
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Yapması zordu ama iyi ki şu iglom var,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Since I've been camping here, I've
felt really great. Maybe this town
just suits me.
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Maybe{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}I should just move here?{{TAG:000F:0005:15002800}}
Yeah, move here!
Think it over!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Desde que estoy acampada aquí,
me noto las pilas cargadas a tope.
Será el ambiente del pueblo, ¿no?
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}¿Y si{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} me mudo aquí?{{TAG:000F:0005:15002800}}
¡Qué gran idea!
Menuda ocurrencia...
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Depuis que j'campe dans l'coin,
j'me sens en super forme.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Faut
croire que l'air d'ici m'réussit !
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}D'ailleurs{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} j'devrais p't'être venir
m'installer ?!{{TAG:000F:0005:15002800}}
Bonne idée !
Réfléchis bien...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Sai, da quando sono qui mi sento
proprio bene. Forse questo posto
fa al caso mio.
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Secondo te{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} mi dovrei trasferire?{{TAG:000F:0005:15002800}}
Ma certo!
Pensaci un po'.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Eigentlich fühl ich mich ja ganz
wohl in dieser Stadt. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Vielleicht
sollte ich herziehen?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Was sagste?{{TAG:000F:0005:15002800}}
Ja, zieh her!
Überleg's dir lieber!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Burada kamp yaptığımdan beri kendimi
acayip iyi hissediyorum. Belki bu kasaba bana
uyuyordur. {{TAG:0003:0017:}}Belki{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}direkt buraya taşınsam?{{TAG:000F:0005:15002800}}
Evet, taşın!
İyice düşün!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}This town has a lot of great folks in
it! I bet it would be fun to live here!
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Should I just go ahead and move in?{{TAG:000F:0005:15002800}}
Yeah, move here!
Think it over!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}¡En este pueblo la gente es la pera!
Buf, cómo tiene que molar vivir
aquí... {{TAG:0003:0017:}}A ver, ¿y si me mudo?{{TAG:000F:0005:15002800}}
¡Sí, deberías!
Es mejor que no...
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Les gens d'ici sont trop cool ! Chuis
sûre que si j'm'installais en ville,
j'm'y plairais bien.
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Tiens, toi qui connais bien l'coin, tu
crois qu'ce s'rait une bonne idée ?{{TAG:000F:0005:15002800}}
Mais carrément !
J'ai un doute...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Questa città è piena di gente tosta!
Sarebbe divertente vivere qui.
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Secondo te mi dovrei trasferire?{{TAG:000F:0005:15002800}}
Sì, vieni a vivere qui!
Pensaci ancora un po'!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Hier in dieser Stadt gibt es echt
viel zu erleben{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}Vielleicht sollte ich
mich hier breit machen?{{TAG:000F:0005:15002800}}
Aber hallo!
Lass es bleiben...
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Bu kasabada harika insanlar var! Burada
yaşamak kesin eğlenceli olur! {{TAG:0003:0017:}}Direkt taşınsam mı?{{TAG:000F:0005:15002800}}
Evet, buraya taşın!
İyice düşün!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Naw, man! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}I'm not ready for that
kind of commitment!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Anyway, I'm here as a tourist. So I
only see what the town is like on
the surface!
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}I'd need to dig a little deeper and
figure out the gritty inner workings
of things first, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}¡Qué va, {{TAG:000E:0006:0C0068006F006D006200720065000A006D0075006A0065007200}}! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Sería demasiada
responsabilidad para mí. ¡No estoy
preparada todavía!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
Además, como estoy de visita solo
veo las cosas buenas... {{TAG:0003:0000:}}¡pero a saber
cómo es esto en realidad!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Hi hi hi !{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} J'étais pas sérieuse !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} J'vais
quand même pas changer ma vie du
tout au tout sur un coup d'tête !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
Bah ouais, c'est pas quelques jours
passés ici qui m'suffiront pour
prendre une décision pareille !
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Faudrait d'jà qu'je sache c'qui
s'passe dans les coulisses, s'tu vois
c'que j'veux dire, {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}No, guarda! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Non sono mica pronta
per un impegno del genere!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}E poi, sono qui come turista. Vedo
solo la facciata di questo posto!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Prima mi conviene scavare un po'
più a fondo e scoprire come
funzionano le cose, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Nee! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Ich bin für so 'nen großen
Schritt einfach noch nicht bereit!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Ich wollt mir als Touri nur mal die
Stadt anschauen, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}nichts weiter,
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Yok canım! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}O kadar büyük bir karara
hazır değilim!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Zaten buraya turist olarak geldim.
Kasabanın sadece dışarıdan görünen yüzünü
biliyorum! {{TAG:0003:0000:}}Önce biraz daha derine inip işlerin
arka planda nasıl yürüdüğünü anlamam lazım,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}¡Anda la osa!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0000:}}Mmm{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Supongo
que en parte tienes razón...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Yo creo que me he dejado llevar
un poco por la emoción. ¡Es que
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0006:}} es muy emocionante!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Yeah, I was only joking! For me to
move here, I'd have to figure out
the internal power structure first!{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}And I'd have to decide if I could find
myself here or whatever{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} That's
what's important, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}¡Que te estaba vacilando! ¿Cómo
me voy a venir aquí sin saber de
qué va la juerga en el pueblo?{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Además, tendría que traerme todas
mis plantas{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Y eso sería muy 
complicado, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Hi hi, pas besoin, j'te faisais
marcher !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Avant d'me lancer dans un truc
pareil, faudrait d'jà que j'fasse un
bilan des forces en place !
Ouaip !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0000:}}Quel territoire appartient à
qui, qui tire les ficelles dans l'ombre
à la mairie... Tout ça, quoi.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Mais surtout, j'devrais être sûre
d'en avoir envie{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} et c'est pas l'cas,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Sì, stavo solo scherzando! Prima
di trasferirmi qui devo capire
la vera forza di questo posto!{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}E poi devo decidere se qui posso
trovare me stessa{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Questo è ciò
che conta davvero, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Evet, şaka yapıyordum! Buraya taşınmam
için önce içerideki güç dengelerini çözmem
gerek!{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}Bir de burada gerçekten kendimi bulabilir
miyim, onu düşünmeliyim{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Asıl önemli olan
bu, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
